about_the_game:
THE STORY

After arriving in Brighthaven, you inherit your late uncle’s failed delivery business. With nothing left but empty warehouses, you re-imagine the space, turning it into a chain of Rage Rooms where people smash objects to release stress.

Build, manage, and grow your destruction therapy empire. Hire staff, upgrade rooms, and help the world break free, one shattered plate at a time.

What to expect:

  • Become an outstanding manager: Recruit a team, manage salaries and skills to optimize the operation of your rooms.

  • Build your demolition empire: Invest your profits to expand your premises, unlock new themed rooms, and ever more surprising objects to destr1oy.

  • Strategy at the heart of chaos: Manage your finances, launch marketing campaigns, and make crucial decisions to attract a diverse clientele and make your business prosper.

  • Advanced customization: Design your "Rage Rooms" to meet your customers' desires, maximize their satisfaction... and your revenue!
